info.title: Mesadesk API
info.description:
REST API for the Mesadesk: the manufacturing value chain from customer
inquiry through order, production plan, shift logbook, quality inspection,
finished-goods stock and dispatch, plus the complaint/CAPA loop that closes
back onto it.

**This document is generated from the running server.** Paths, methods, request
bodies, authentication and the permission each route is gated on are read from
the live Express router stack and the Zod schemas that validate the requests, so
they cannot drift from what is enforced.

### Conventions

- Base path `/api`. Request and response bodies are JSON.
- Every failure uses the same envelope: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } }`.
  Branch on `error.code`, which is stable; `message` is for humans.
- Writes are validated with Zod and return `422` with a field-level error map on failure.
- Lifecycle transitions are their own endpoints (`/orders/{id}/cancel`,
  `/logbooks/{id}/submit`, `/capas/{id}/close`) and are transactional where they
  touch several tables.
- Every request is scoped to the caller's organization; there is no way to read
  or write another tenant's rows.
- Response schemas come from the Prisma datamodel. Where an endpoint includes a
  relation, the nested object may carry only the fields that endpoint selects.

### Authorization

Authentication establishes *who* you are; each route additionally requires a
feature permission, listed in its description as **Requires permission**. Roles
map to permissions server-side — the client's own checks are cosmetic only.

**Requires permission:** `mesaerp.procurement.manage`

parameters.name: legalEntityId
parameters.description: Legal company id inside the authenticated organization.

parameters.name: x-org
parameters.description: Select one of the authenticated user's non-inactive organization memberships by id or slug. Foreign selections fail closed.

200.description: The company goods receipts, including ordered decimal-string lines and immutable source links.

401.description: `unauthenticated` — no usable credential, or no membership resolved for it.

403.description:
- `forbidden` — The caller does not hold the explicit `mesaerp.procurement.manage` grant for this legal company; administrator status alone does not bypass the company grant.
- `service_not_enabled` — MesaERP is not active for the caller organization.
- `service_not_entitled` — The source-to-pay router cannot find an active MesaERP entitlement in the resolved identity.

404.description: - `legal_entity_not_found` — The legal company is outside the authenticated tenant.

post.description:
May start independently or snapshot an approved purchase order; a company vendor is required in either flow. The server recalculates line and document totals from validated decimal strings, stores immutable party/source snapshots, writes audit and outbox evidence, and scopes idempotency to this operation. Every caller requires the exact `mesaerp.procurement.manage` company grant, without an administrator bypass.

**Requires permission:** `mesaerp.procurement.manage`

parameters.name: legalEntityId
parameters.description: Legal company id inside the authenticated organization.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. Send a stable 8-128 character key using letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon or hyphen. Replaying the same key and payload returns the original result; reusing it with a different payload is rejected.

parameters.name: x-org
parameters.description: Select one of the authenticated user's non-inactive organization memberships by id or slug. Foreign selections fail closed.

201.description: The created draft goods receipt with server-calculated totals and rowVersion 0.

400.description: - `idempotency_key_required` — Idempotency-Key is absent, malformed or outside the allowed 8-128 character range.

401.description: `unauthenticated` — no usable credential, or no membership resolved for it.

403.description:
- `forbidden` — The caller does not hold the explicit `mesaerp.procurement.manage` grant for this legal company; administrator status alone does not bypass the company grant.
- `service_not_enabled` — MesaERP is not active for the caller organization.
- `service_not_entitled` — The source-to-pay router cannot find an active MesaERP entitlement in the resolved identity.

404.description:
- `legal_entity_not_found` — The legal company is outside the authenticated tenant.
- `vendor_not_found` — The selected vendor is outside this legal company.
- `source_document_not_found` — The optional source document is outside this legal company.

409.description:
- `idempotency_conflict` — The same idempotency key was already committed with a different request payload.
- `financial_year_missing` — No configured financial year covers the document date.
- `financial_year_locked` — The document date falls in a locked financial year.
- `document_number_exists` — The document number already exists for this type and financial year.
- `source_document_not_approved` — An optional source document has not completed approval.
- `vendor_blocked` — The selected vendor is blocked.
- `vendor_not_approved` — A purchase order vendor is not approved or conditionally approved.

422.description:
- `amount_out_of_range` — A server-calculated line or document amount exceeds the supported non-negative decimal(18,2) range.
- `discount_exceeds_line_value` — A line discount exceeds quantity multiplied by unit price.
- `tax_amount_mismatch` — A supplied line taxAmount does not equal the server calculation from taxable amount and tax rate.
- `invalid_source_document` — The optional source document type cannot source this document type.
- `source_document_required` — A line supplies sourceLineId without a sourceDocumentId.
- `source_line_mismatch` — A sourceLineId does not belong to the selected source document.
- `vendor_source_mismatch` — The supplied vendor conflicts with the approved source snapshot.
